name: libpcap BPF compiler
description: The BPF compiler translates human-readable filter expressions into Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) bytecode. It uses a lexical scanner and a Yacc-based parser to generate an intermediate code representation (icode), which is then optimized via the bpf_optimize function and finally converted into executable BPF instructions (fcode). This feature is essential for packet filtering in various capture environments.
